title: Switch issue automation to client-id
description: Use `client-id` (preferred over deprecated `app-id`) for the GitHub App token in issue automation.

title: Add 7-day Dependabot cooldown
description: Add a 7-day cooldown to the Dependabot GitHub Actions update config. This prevents Dependabot from immediately pulling newly released dependency versions, reducing supply-chain risk from opportunistic package compromises and stability risk from regressions in new releases.

title: Add code of conduct contact email
description: Adds `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` using Contributor Covenant v3.0, with `codeofconduct@posit.co` as the enforcement contact, and links to it from the README.

title: Slow dependabot actions group to monthly
description: Change the dependabot github-actions ecosystem schedule from weekly to monthly to reduce churn from action bumps.

title: Surface Discussions on the New Issue page
description:
## Summary

Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` so the New Issue page surfaces a "Questions and feedback" contact link to this repo's Discussions before a user opens an issue.

`blank_issues_enabled` stays `true` so bug reports can still be filed against this repo's tracker — the contact link is a soft nudge toward Discussions, not a hard redirect.

This matches the same config added to the satellite image repos so the funnel is consistent across the org.

title: Link Kubernetes section to chart docs on docs.posit.co
description:
## Summary

- Helm chart versions `>= 0.20.0` default to the Posit images covered by this meta repository (see [rstudio/helm#870](https://github.com/rstudio/helm/pull/870)).
- Point readers at the chart docs on docs.posit.co plus the [image migration guide](https://docs.posit.co/helm/docs/migrating-to-posit-images.html) instead of routing through each per-product README's Kubernetes section.

Closes part of posit-dev/images-shared#427. Hold until [rstudio/helm#870](https://github.com/rstudio/helm/pull/870) is merged and chart `0.20.0` is published.

title: Remove preview disclaimer from README
description:
## Summary

- Remove the "in preview" callout from `README.md` now that the Posit container images are generally available.

Refs posit-dev/images-shared#329.

title: Expand README with branding, Docker Compose example, and updated links
description:
## Summary
- Add Posit logo banner, intro paragraph, and trial license link
- Add Docker Compose example for running Connect, Package Manager, and Workbench together
- Refresh Quick Start and Image tag format examples to current 2026.04.x versions
- Correct the Image variants description so Package Manager (no Quarto) and Workbench Standard are accurately covered
- Add a note about specialized images and link to the images-specialized repo
- Refresh Security and ARM64 support sections; note multi-platform support for Package Manager and Connect
- Apply Posit style guide fixes throughout: sentence-case headings, active voice, em dashes replaced with colons, short-form product names after first mention, removed time-anchored "now", removed dangling product-license sentence
- Update bakery configuration reference links to point to the new docs site

## Test plan
- [ ] Render README on GitHub and verify logo banner displays correctly in light/dark mode
- [ ] Verify all links resolve (trial license, bakery configuration anchors, product docs, images-specialized)
- [ ] Confirm Docker Compose snippet is syntactically valid YAML
- [ ] Spot-check that version examples (Connect 2026.04.1, Package Manager 2026.04.2, Workbench 2026.04.0) match published image tags

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

title: Use POSIT_PLATFORM secrets for app token
description:
## Summary

Replace the generic `APP_ID` / `APP_PRIVATE_KEY` secrets with the app-specific
`POSIT_PLATFORM_APP_ID` / `POSIT_PLATFORM_PEM` secrets provisioned by
[rstudio/github-iac](https://github.com/rstudio/github-iac).

The `posit-platform` GitHub App is already installed on this repo and its
credentials are already shared with it via the Pulumi config, so this is a
drop-in rename with no infrastructure changes required.

## Test plan

- [ ] Trigger the issue automation workflow (open a test issue) and confirm
      the run still succeeds
- [ ] Confirm the bot actor on the resulting label / project-add events is
      still `posit-platform[bot]`

## Summary

Restructure the meta-repo README to lead with running containers, not build architecture.

- Add installation guide links after each Quick Start

- Document all image tag formats including `{version}-{os}`
- Note Ubuntu 24.04 as default OS
- Document image variants (Standard and Minimal)

Part of a coordinated documentation update across the Posit Container Image ecosystem.

title: Group dependabot security updates into one PR
description:
Dependabot's `groups` key only covers version updates by default;
security-alert PRs need an explicit `applies-to: security-updates`
group or they arrive individually, ungrouped.

Add a security sibling group to the `actions` group so a future
security alert lands as one grouped PR instead of one per
dependency.
